# Artifact 10: Data Design Integration & Logical Schema

**Generated By:** Agent_04_DataArchitect
**Domain Focus:** Schema Synthesis & Relational Constraints

## 1. System CRUD Lifecycle Matrix
*Maps which actors have Create, Read, Update, Delete permissions over specific Domain Entities during specific Tournament States.*

| Entity | Actor | INIT State | PRE-TOURNAMENT | LIVE State | ARCHIVED State |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tournament** | Delegate | C, R, U, D | R, U | R | R (Locked) |
| **Players** | Player | C, R, U | R | R | R |
| **Draws / Matches** | Delegate | None | C, R, U, D (Drafts) | R | R (Locked) |
| **Match Scores** | Umpire | None | None | R, U (Scoped) | R (Locked) |
| **Audit Log** | System / DB Trigger | C, R | C, R | C, R | C, R (Append Only) |

> [!CAUTION]
> **Data Integrity Rule:** No human actor (not even the Delegate) has `Update` or `Delete` permissions on the `Audit Log` at any stage. It is an append-only cryptographic ledger generated via strict PostgreSQL DB triggers.

## 2. Main Transaction Logical Code Blueprint (Prisma Schema Draft)
*Translation of the Conceptual ERD into highly relational Prisma ORM syntax.*

```prisma
// sprint_22/phase_2_data/schema.prisma

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

model Tournament {
  id          String      @id @default(uuid())
  name        String
  status      TournamentStatus @default(INIT)
  categories  Category[]
  auditLogs   AuditLog[]
  createdAt   DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime    @updatedAt
}

enum TournamentStatus {
  INIT
  PRE_TOURNAMENT
  LIVE
  POST_TOURNAMENT
  ARCHIVED
  SUSPENDED // Emergency state
}

model Match {
  id          String      @id @default(uuid())
  categoryId  String
  category    Category    @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  
  player1Id   String?     // Nullable for Byes or TBD advancing players
  player1     Player?     @relation("PlayerOne", fields: [player1Id], references: [id])
  
  player2Id   String?
  player2     Player?     @relation("PlayerTwo", fields: [player2Id], references: [id])
  
  round       Int         // e.g. 16 for R16
  status      MatchStatus @default(PENDING)
  scoreState  Json        @default("{}") // High-frequency volatile data
  
  courtId     String?
}

enum MatchStatus {
  PENDING
  ACTIVE
  CONCLUDED
  WALKOVER
}

model AuditLog {
  id             String     @id @default(uuid())
  tournamentId   String
  tournament     Tournament @relation(fields: [tournamentId], references: [id])
  actorId        String     // ID of the user/system making the change
  actionType     String     // e.g. "SCORE_MUTATION", "DRAW_PUBLISHED"
  mutationPayload Json      // The exact delta of the data changed
  timestamp      DateTime   @default(now())
}
```

## 3. Data Dictionary Extracts

*   **`scoreState` (JSONB on Match Entity):**
    *   *Type:* JSONB
    *   *Constraint:* Must contain valid schema `{ p1Sets: int, p2Sets: int, p1Games: int, p2Games: int, p1Points: string, p2Points: string, server: string }`
    *   *Business Rule:* Evaluated by client-side TennisEngine before pushing mutation. DB accepts blindly to ensure <200ms latency, but validates structure.
*   **`status` (Enum on Tournament Entity):**
    *   *Constraint:* Can only move strictly forward (`INIT` -> `PRE` -> `LIVE`). Exception is `SUSPENDED` which can override `LIVE` and return to `LIVE`.
    *   *Business Rule:* Transitioning to `ARCHIVED` triggers a backend background job that drops all `scoreState` granular histories and calculates aggregate statistics to save database space.
